newsitem.title: FRANCE: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM DELAYED.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WOMEN'S GIANT SLALOM DELAYED.

text.p: A women's World Cup Alpine skiing giant slalom was put back by an hour in the French resort of Morzine on Sunday because the snow was too soft.
The race, scheduled to start at 0830 GMT, was delayed after the forerunners had completed the course.
Organisers said products used to prepare the course were to blame and they hoped the situation would improve after an hour. Germany's Martina Ertl was to be the first starter.
